messages:
Noura: kicking off RetailEdge POC thread. asks: streaming SDK + websocket, structured JSON output for purchases, customer KMS, SAML SSO, and a baseline dedicated quote for EU region. any immediate blockers?
Ethan: EU-only means Private or Dedicated with strong routing controls. Legal will want the KMS diagram and an assurance about key wrapping.
Priya: for streaming we recommend ephemeral tokens + adaptive_batching:true. sample curl upgrade we give them in docs. also note that function-calling fallback helps when schema parsing fails.
SE-Tom: quant note: quantization saves cost but can change numeric parsing. i'll request a 200-sample prompt set to run fp16 vs 8-bit diff and return precision recall numbers.
Dan: pricing ballpark: 8-GPU reserved pool EU ~ $Ak/mo at committed util; cross-region failover +20-25%. need qps and tokens/day to firm numbers.
Security-Bot: SOC2 doc available internally. open ticket SEC-771 for KMS key-flow diagram. ephemeral creds for streaming supported.
Noura: action items: Dan = draft quote, SE-Tom = eval plan, Priya = sample SDK snippets & schema examples, Ethan = legal/infra loop. i'll book a 30m call once prompt set arrives. ping here when updates are ready. :thumbsup:
